rounds.q: What % of Americans expect over 10 other people at Thanksgiving dinner?
rounds.why: Just 5% of US adults planned to eat Thanksgiving dinner alone.
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, Thanksgiving survey of 9,609 US adults (Nov 2024 data)
rounds.fun: For 26% of Americans, dinner means more than 10 others. Somebody find more chairs!

rounds.q: How many days did the first Thanksgiving feast in 1621 last?
rounds.why: About 90 Wampanoag men joined the English settlers for the harvest feast.
rounds.src: Plimoth Patuxet Museums, Thanksgiving history (1621 event)
rounds.fun: Three days of feasting with about 90 Wampanoag guests. Now that is a long dinner.

rounds.q: What year was New York's big Thanksgiving parade first held?
rounds.why: That first parade marched 6 miles. Today's route is 2.5 miles.
rounds.src: History.com, The First Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade (1924 event); Afar (2026 route)
rounds.fun: Marching since 1924! The first parade went 6 miles, and now it is a comfy 2.5.

rounds.q: How many million people watched 2025's most-watched Thanksgiving football game?
rounds.why: The 57.2 million audience set a record for a regular season pro football game.
rounds.src: CBS Sports, Nielsen ratings release (2025 data)
rounds.fun: 57.2 million watched, a regular season record. That is one very full living room.

rounds.q: What year did the White House turkey pardon become a yearly tradition?
rounds.why: That year's pardoned turkey was sent to live out its days on a children's farm.
rounds.src: White House Historical Association, turkey pardon history (1989 event)
rounds.fun: Yearly since 1989! That lucky turkey got to retire to a children's farm.
